Gg.bar_b_note: A neutral grey stage with flat light gives no Valheim-class atmosphere, and the gold-blotched spider reads as a patterned asset, not a Palworld-finish creature with rim-lit material.

Ql.bar_b_note: The dark mole silhouette and pink snout read cleanly, but there is no world light and the spines carry only a dim violet sheen instead of bright storm arcs.

Wu.bar_b_note: Side B's dark navy wolf matches the owner bar, but the neutral stage gives no atmosphere and the belly-up faint roll breaks the finish.

Hv.bar_b_note: The frames look the same as Gg: yellow blotches cover the black coat, with no bright arcs and no world light.

Le.bar_b_note: A warm, readable stylised elder villager whose green-and-brown palette sits in the key art's world, though he is shown on a black void with no scene light.

Ns.bar_b_note: The Meadows has flat, even light, a low-poly grey boulder and sparse grass cards, so it falls short of Palworld density and Valheim light whichever wall is placed.

Zr.bar_b_note: The blue-grey translucent panel fits the UI direction, but the muddy, near-black rainy world behind it has no readable light or depth.

Xh.bar_b_note: Side B's saturated blue finned drake is appealing and grounded, but it is shown on a bare stage, and side A's faint frames float and lose texture.

top_changes.change: Rebuild the storm-creature materials (Gg/Hv spider, Ql mole, Wu wolf) as a dark base coat with thin, bright white-violet emissive arcs and light bloom, so the arcs pop as on the owner's Stormursa and Tanglevolt, instead of yellow blotches or dim painted streaks.

Ship side A's craft panel scale (large recipe and ingredient text, nothing truncated) and turn the Craft/Leave hints into controller-first glyph buttons with teal/gold accent, sized to read on a 7-inch screen. Use side A's built homestead wall (stone footing, cap, braced frame) rather than side B's pale card panel, and give the wall thicker posts and tinted infill.

Redo the faint clips so they stay grounded and keep their material: Xh-A floats in faint mid and turns grey/untextured in faint end, and Wu rolls belly-up through a black blob in faint mid. Raise Ql above the 1.80 m trainer.
